title: MACROGENICS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: MacroGenics, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 8, 2026, announcing that the FDA removed a partial clinical hold on the company's Phase 2 LINNET study of lorigerlimab, an investigational bispecific DART molecule targeting PD-1 and CTLA-4, in patients with gynecologic cancers. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
key_points: MacroGenics is a Delaware corporation (ticker MGNX) listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market
FDA removed partial clinical hold on Phase 2 LINNET study of lorigerlimab
Lorigerlimab is a bispecific DART molecule targeting PD-1 and CTLA-4
Study indication is patients with gynecologic cancers
Filing signed by Jeffrey Peters, Senior Vice President and General Counsel
This is a company-specific biotech/clinical trial announcement
